title: Practical Assessment of Agentic Systems in Acoustics
abstract: arXiv:2610.39685v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In engineering, applications of artificial intelligence have so far been largely limited to surrogate models and optimization tasks. Large language models changed this, as they can write software from a task given in words. Placed inside a harness, a system of components that lets it search for information and execute software, such a model becomes an agent that can take over recurring engineering tasks. This work measures how the model and the elements of the harness shape the performance and behavior of the agent in two common acoustic applications. In the first, the agent detects and locates faults in audio recordings from a vehicle interior with near-perfect accuracy. A benchmark on this task shows that a weak model sets a limit that no harness design can overcome, and that design choices take effect only once the model is capable enough to use them. translated_title: 声学领域智能体系统的实践评估
translated_abstract: 在工程领域，人工智能的应用迄今为止主要局限于代理模型和优化任务。大语言模型改变了这一局面，因为它们可以根据以文字描述的任务来编写软件。当被置于一个工具框架中——一个允许其搜索信息和执行软件的组件系统——这样的模型就成为智能体，能够接管重复性的工程任务。本工作通过两个常见的声学应用，测量了模型以及工具框架各要素如何影响智能体的性能和行为。在第一个应用中，智能体以近乎完美的准确率检测并定位车辆内部音频记录中的故障。基于该任务的基准测试表明，弱模型会设定一个任何工具框架设计都无法突破的上限，而设计选择只有在模型具备足够能力去利用它们时才会生效。在第二个应用中，即超材料单胞设计的案例研究，智能体
tldr: 本文通过车辆音频故障检测和超材料单胞设计两个声学任务实证评估了大语言模型智能体系统，发现模型自身能力是性能上限、任何工具框架设计都无法弥补，而框架设计只有在模型足够强大时才能发挥作用。
en_tdlr: This work empirically assesses LLM-based agentic systems on two acoustics tasks—vehicle audio fault detection and metamaterial unit-cell design—showing that model capability sets a hard limit no harness design can overcome, while harness design choices take effect only once the model is capable enough to exploit them.
